description: repos/** is the vendored read-only Effect reference subtree and is never Renovate's to update (#108); the other ignorePaths restate config:recommended's :ignoreModulesAndTests, which setting ignorePaths replaces. Effect stays pinned to its 4.0.0-rc line (bumped deliberately with migration review), agent-bundle and effect-rstest track pkg.pr.new preview URLs, typescript is pinned by the tsgo integration, and @types/node stays below 24 while Node 22.19 remains supported; Renovate manages the rest on a weekly schedule.
